label: Fires at D1 when last trial reached S2 after S1 (esp. rewarded) two trials back.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (tv("reward", -2) == tv("state", -2)) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r")
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (tv("state", -3) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (belief > 0.5) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (tv("reward", -3) == 1) * (tv("state", -3) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r")
explanation: Very sparse D1-only feature (nonzero on 1.7% of steps, zero at GO and D2). Its magnitude rises at D1 when the previous trial reached S2, most strongly when the trial before that reached S1 and was rewarded (a switch from S1-rewarded to S2), i.e. S2 arrives when S1 looked good. After a2 S2 rewarded (expected S2 trials) it is lower. The term tv(reward,-2)==tv(state,-2) is effectively S1 rewarded two trials back. Belief that S1 is good adds a little. The free fit (S2 last trial x unrewarded / S1 2-3 trials back / belief) adds little. The profile ceiling over additive cues is only 0.17, so most of the variance (which S2 trials make it fire) is unexplained. No future variables used.
